senses.sense_definition: A master of ceremonies; a person who hosts an event, introduces performers, and keeps the audience engaged.

examples.text: The <w>emcee</w> kept the audience laughing between speeches at the charity gala.
She was chosen as the <w>emcee</w> for the annual awards ceremony because of her charismatic stage presence.

senses.sense_definition: A hip-hop artist or rapper, especially one who performs live.

examples.text: Several talented <w>emcees</w> took turns performing over the heavy drum beat.
He established himself as a respected <w>emcee</w> in the local underground music scene.

senses.sense_definition: To act as the host or master of ceremonies for an event.

examples.text: She was invited to <w>emcee</w> the festival after doing a fantastic job last year.
A famous comedian <w>emceed</w> the dinner and introduced every speaker with a clever joke.

senses.sense_definition: To perform rap lyrics, especially in a live hip-hop performance.

examples.text: He began <w>emceeing</w> at neighbourhood block parties before securing a major record deal.
The artist demonstrated his ability to <w>emcee</w> with intricate rhyme schemes and fast tempos.
